## Description

A vulnerability was discovered in etcd where the server is vulnerable to denial of service via multipart MIME parsing.

**Impact:** An attacker can crash the etcd server by sending a crafted multipart MIME request.

**Affected versions:** v3.4.x, v3.5.x

**References:**
- https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-24790
- https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx
author: security-researcher
title: CVE-2024-24790: etcd vulnerable to denial of service via multipart MIME parsing
